reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis aligns well with known effects of Al on phase formation and properties in high-entropy alloys, although the exact interplay between entropic and enthalpic contributions remains somewhat complex.
reasons.testability: The proposed experiment of systematically varying Al content and examining phase evolution and property changes is straightforward and provides a clear way to confirm or refute the mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: This hypothesis offers direct guidance for composition tuning to optimize multiple performance metrics in Al–Co–Cr–Fe–Ni HEAs, making it valuable for researchers.
